title: Vera proposes a setting inside a Space's settings, starting with the calendar's time zone and sky markers

source.ref: Owner ask 2026-11-03 16:38Z (Vera answers any question about functions and settings and makes the changes the user directs, always confirming before it writes), 20:39Z (I approve everything, get this done) and 2026-11-04 06:13Z (approved to get this done); Vera assistants plan /mnt/project-files/vera-assistants-2026-11-03/REPORT.md, phase V3 (settings change for toggles, choices and numbers in the settings sections, role-checked).

detail:
After LIVE-2157 and LIVE-2185 Vera could turn an area of a Space on or off and say who can use it, but no setting inside a settings section. Now lib/ai/vera/space-settings.ts holds the typed list of settings she may propose, each with what it means, where it lives, how a value is checked, and the card words; it starts with the calendar's time zone (checked against the tz database) and sky markers (on or off). For an owner or admin the turn adds each setting that applies to this Space with its value now (calendar settings only while the Calendar is on). She proposes with the set_space_setting tool; the model chokepoint refuses a setting or value off the list, and a tap goes through the calendar page's own setSpaceTimeZone and setSpaceSkyMarkers, which re-check the caller. Prose, money, publishing and anything that cannot be undone never go on the list.

Shipped: lib/ai/vera/space-settings.ts, the set_space_setting tool, the chokepoint branch, settingsNow in lib/ai/vera/turn.ts, the confirm in app/onboarding/vera-actions.ts, the chat button, tests and probe.
